sources.license_note: FDA website policies (fda.gov/about-fda/about-website/website-policies, read 2026-10-24): content is not copyrighted and is in the public domain unless otherwise noted. Paraphrased.
sources.impact_evidence: USTR 2024 Notorious Markets report as reported by CBS (9 Jan 2025): of about 35,000 online pharmacies, 96% broke the law and about 20 new illegal sites appear daily ([CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/texas/news/online-pharmacies-illegal-selling-ineffective-drugs); the USTR report itself was not opened). Historically, pharmaceutical spam was about 59.1% of all spam in Jan 2011 and up to 85% in May 2010 ([Dark Reading on MessageLabs](https://www.darkreading.com/cyber-risk/symantec-low-spam-levels-a-result-of-shifts-in-botnets-pharmaceutical-spam-gangs))
sources.weaknesses: Justified by health-safety risk and distinct official guidance, not by current frequency: the FTC 2024 category list does not mention pharmacy. Spam figures are old
